onboarding modal

What it is

Onboarding modal on pure black: 'Connected to the Core' card whose hero is a rotating 3D wireframe/point-cloud cube (icosahedron-like mesh of glowing dots and edges), slowly tumbling; Back/Skip/Continue footer.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-100%
Black scene with faint dotted wave mesh in the background corners; centered dark card: hero window with a luminous dot-matrix polyhedron tumbling on two axes (perspective-correct 3D), heading 'Connected to the Core', 2-line body, 'Learn more' link, footer Back / Skip / Continue (white). The mesh rotates continuously; dots shimmer with depth attenuation.

trigger
autoplay ambient

modal card, 3D point-cloud polyhedron (canvas/WebGL), dotted wave background

Build prompt

Build an onboarding modal with a 3D point-cloud hero. Scene: pure black page, faint dotted sine-wave meshes drifting in the far background (2 planes, 5% opacity dots, 30s drift). Modal 520px, #111 surface, 1px white/8 border, radius 16: hero area 240px tall rendering a tumbling icosahedron made of glowing dots at vertices + sampled along edges - implement in canvas 2D with a tiny 3D pipeline (rotate X 0.13rad/s, Y 0.08rad/s, perspective divide, dot radius and alpha scaled by z). Dots white, slight bloom (shadowBlur). Below: title 'Connected to the Core' 18px, muted 2-line body, inline 'Learn more', footer row: ghost 'Back', ghost 'Skip', white 'Continue'. Entry: modal fades + rises 12px (400ms ease-out), mesh fades in 200ms later.
